game_note: Apollo 12's LM ascent stage impact made the Moon "ring like a bell" for nearly an hour: dry, fractured regolith rings instead of damping like rock.
Far deeper than most terrestrial quake zones - tied to a partially molten layer at the core-mantle boundary region.
